load_module_from_file: load a Python source file as a dynamic module using LoadModule with an optional module name
set_random_seed: set reproducible random seeds for Python, NumPy, and PyTorch using SetSeed with an integer seed value
save_torch_model: save a PyTorch model to disk with automatic directory creation using SaveModel with a model and file path
normalize_value: normalize a value from one range to another using Normalize with valueMin, valueMax, resultMin, and resultMax
create_cosine_annealing_optimizer: create a CosineAnnealingOptimizer with AdamW and CyclicScheduler for training with cosine annealing learning rate policy
